author: commonsense-agent
title: commonsense-v1: scope, sources and checks
body: Scope decided by principle: class hierarchy and disjointness, typical uses/abilities/places/properties/parts of common nouns, lifetimes (older, contemporaries, outlived, ages), family (gendered children/siblings, uncle/aunt, in-laws, cousins, relatives), geography (continent, country, same country/continent), units (dimension, base amounts, conversions). Sources: WordNet 3.0 (Princeton licence) for ~2000 common-noun classes (sense chosen with ConceptNet IsA hints, proper nouns excluded, collisions with core/world names reused or left out), ConceptNet 5.7 CC BY 4.0 OMCS edges only (weight >= 2, offensive vocabulary filtered), rules by five Claude Haiku batches validated by tools/commonsense/check.mjs and corrected by commonsense-agent (strict year comparisons, self-pair guards, no city/country disjointness because of city-states). Chat path uses only positive-body rules (with compare/compute); defaults and integrity constraints serve the knowledge path. Owner correction 2026-10-02: no manual approval; the layer is used once the automated checks pass.

author: commonsense-agent
title: eval-commonsense-v1, knowledge level and regression: 28/30 with the layer vs 13/30 without, 0 wrong; world30 replay unchanged (24/30)
body: Gold circuits (eval/commonsense/gold-circuits.mjs) executed through askMemory on world-v1 with commonsense-v1 (private root, then the product chat_data) and on the previous world-v1: with 28 correct / 0 wrong / 2 unknown of 30 (median 157 ms); without 13 / 0 / 13 unknown / 4 not expressible (median 9 ms). Still unknown with the layer: 'Is a hammer a tool?' (WordNet sense chosen: the gun part, mechanical_device) and 'Is gold a metal?' (no is_a path from gold to metallic_element). Replay of the 30 recorded world30 circuits (no author): 24/30 in both memories; the only difference is q28 'How many countries are in Europe?' (a wrong count without, an honest incomplete with). Sampled integrity check (120 persons, 240 places, 120 mixed per constraint): no error-severity violation; warnings: acharya_pingala lived > 125 years (dates of an ancient person), palestine has two capitals. Two fixes on the way: a subclass-disjointness rule exploded the is_a closure (removed; 29 disjoint pairs stated as facts), and reasoning/slice/demand.mjs now seeds every written constant of an all-constant call (older_than isaac_newton albert_einstein keyed 2 facts instead of scanning 17,605 born_on facts), deferring the extra constants after the first atom so a hub constant (located_in ?y france) never becomes the first key. Author-level arm (GLM 5.3 via omp): without 6 correct / 1 wrong / 19 unknown / 6 parser failed of 32; with arm stopped by the z.ai usage limit, resumed after the reset.

author: commonsense-agent
title: eval-commonsense-v1 author level (Qwen3.8 27b): 17/32 correct with the layer vs 7/32 without, 0 wrong in both
body: Author llmapiprovider/Qwen3.8 27b through omp (deviation: GLM 5.3 quota exhausted). With: 17 correct, 0 wrong, 7 honest unknown, 8 parser failed, median turn 19.5 s. Without: 7, 0, 16, 9, median 19.1 s. Gains: class membership (violin, whale, dog, car), disjointness refutations (Paris/Einstein/Germany not a person/city), typical location (pillow), lifetimes (Newton older, Shakespeare before Newton, Marx younger), capital of Kenya in Africa. Losses: cs20 and cs05/cs14 parser failures, cs29 clarify (author variance; one run each). Latency unchanged.

author: free-sources-agent
title: Free common-sense sources: licence verdicts and candidate slice layers
body: Verified licences (2026-10-02, DS011 rows): GenericsKB-Best CC BY 4.0 per dataset card, but per part only Waterloo rows used (ARC CC BY-SA 4.0, SimpleWikipedia CC BY-SA, ConceptNet-synthesized and TupleKB rows of unrecorded licence excluded); ATOMIC 2020 CC BY 4.0 (README + LICENSE in zip), physical relations partly from ConceptNet so 305 tuples equal to BY-SA ConceptNet edges removed; Ascent++ CC BY 4.0 (site footer); Quasimodo CC BY 2.0 (MPI page); Wikidata units CC0. Built by tools/commonsense/free-sources/<source>.mjs (fetch/build), linking only to classes of core-min/core-en/commonsense-v1 by label or inflection, ranked by book word frequency (token counts only) x source confidence, dedup against commonsense-v1. Layers (chat:false): free-atomic2020-slice-v1 1500 (used_for 900, found_at 237, typical_property 220, typically_has 82, capable_of 61); free-ascentpp-slice-v1 1500 (typical_property 600, capable_of 450, typically_has 186, made_of_material 145, used_for 65, found_at 53, part_of 1); free-quasimodo-slice-v1 1198 (typical_property 675, capable_of 458, ...); free-genericskb-slice-v1 329 (only simple sentence shapes convert); free-wikidata-units-slice-v1 29 units with dimension_of, base_amount (18) and exact si_factor (new rational predicate). conceptnet-bysa-v1: 178 facts (157 is_a, 21 part_of; DBpedia edges excluded as instance-level), imported by nothing, owner question Q-DATA-8. Observation: quality of web-extracted slices (Quasimodo, Ascent++) is mixed; usefulness to be measured on the book problems by the knowledge-mining trial harness.

author: linker-cs-agent
title: Author failures on commonsense-v1 that were not missing facts: causes and generic fixes
body: Rows cs04 cs07 cs13 cs16 cs17 cs27 cs28 cs29 (Qwen3.8 27b). Causes: (1) cs13: a text-typed role (used_for object) was resolved as an entity. (2) cs27-29: no quantity form; the author wrote '3000 seconds' as an entity and length_of for units. (3) cs04/cs07: commonsense build chose the wrong WordNet sense (hammer = gunlock part; gold = coins so no is_a gold metallic_element) and gave 'metal' as alias to alloy; the Kobayashi Issa / kilometre texts were near-miss renderer artifacts of that time and no longer appear. (4) cs16/cs17: the not_contemporary rule called lived_before with the second person bound only by a variable, so the slice scanned born_on. Fixes: text roles kept as written; compare of two quoted quantities lowered onto the predicates declared reading unit_amount/unit_dimension (exact rational bound, different dimensions give unknown); chooseEntity label-over-alias where the role expects a class; demand seeds caller-bound positions weakly through rule calls; build sense rules (description agreement by margin 3, equal tag counts broken by hyponyms, own-sense aliases only). Rerun (private root, 23 rows): failing 15 -> 11 correct, 0 wrong; control 8/8. Open: free-text matching (flying vs fly), Mozart namesake clarification by policy, mention_not_used on stated family facts (cs31/32), product chat_data world-v1 rebuild over the regenerated layer.
